mapper.select: SELECT id FROM public.department WHERE id = #{departmentId} AND active FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO public.member (name, phone, active) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, TRUE) RETURNING id
INSERT INTO public.department_membership ( department_id, member_id, joined_at, created_by_account_id ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, #{memberId}, #{joinedAt}, #{actorAccountId} ) RETURNING id

SELECT assignment.id AS assignment_id, card.id AS card_id, card.status AS card_status FROM public.nfc_card_assignment AS assignment JOIN public.nfc_card AS card ON card.id = assignment.nfc_card_id WHERE assignment.department_id = #{departmentId} AND assignment.member_id = #{memberId} AND assignment.unassigned_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF assignment, card
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nfc_card (uid, status) VALUES (#{uid}, 'AVAILABLE') ON CONFLICT (uid) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, uid, status FROM public.nfc_card WHERE uid = #{uid} FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO public.nfc_card_assignment ( nfc_card_id, department_id, membership_id, member_id, assigned_by_account_id, assigned_at ) VALUES ( #{cardId}, #{departmentId}, #{membershipId}, #{memberId}, #{actorAccountId}, #{assignedAt} ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE public.member AS member SET active = FALSE WHERE member.id = #{memberId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.department_membership AS membership WHERE membership.member_id = member.id AND membership.ended_at IS NULL )
